trailhead.label: Passo Campolongo (1,875 m), parking and bus stop beside the Cherz I chairlift base on the SP244. A path climbs about 220 m from here to the Cherz plateau, where the loop begins; the Cherz I open chair covers the same climb when it runs

cautions: Heat risk is high on this walk: start early and carry extra water.
Paths and tracks shared with mountain bikes.
Ski-area service tracks: occasional service vehicles.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
